valuation.title: AI-exposed public-company multiples, not AI-only P/E
valuation.provider: Stock Analysis; page credits S&P Global Market Intelligence for fundamental/historical data
valuation.definition: Trailing P/E is share price divided by trailing annual EPS. Values below are provider-quoted P/E, with an arithmetic cross-check against displayed price and EPS. They are not independently rebuilt from filings.
valuation.forward_definition: Provider field Forward PE; forecast earnings rather than realized earnings. Exact forecast horizon and GAAP/adjusted EPS basis were not verified; do not label these NTM or directly comparable to GAAP trailing P/E without further verification.
valuation.forward_display_recommendation: Optional provider-reported companion column with the definition limitation visible; otherwise omit pending methodology verification.
valuation.aggregation: Do not average company P/E ratios; no sector aggregate calculated.
caveats: Whole-company earnings include non-AI operations and may contain investment gains, tax effects, or other nonrecurring items.
A multiple does not establish incremental AI profitability or investment return.
Memory earnings are cyclical; forecast earnings may be near a cyclical peak.

gdp.numerator_provenance: Supplied by parent task; not independently re-audited in this subtask
gdp.label: Five global builders TTM capex equals 1.74% of the scale of latest annualized US nominal GDP
gdp.caveat: Scale comparison only, not share of US GDP or contribution to US GDP growth. Global corporate capex includes foreign spending/imported equipment and differing fiscal windows; denominator is latest quarterly seasonally adjusted annual rate, not matching TTM GDP.

supply_signals.caveat: All-company foundry revenue, not AI-only; advanced nodes also serve non-AI customers. Recognized sales are stronger evidence than capacity plans, but do not establish end-user AI ROI or cash collection.

supply_signals.type: Recognized sales plus separately identified prospective capacity
supply_signals.caveat: Capacity expansion and customer commitments indicate expected demand, not recognized or paid end-user demand. Net sales cover AI and non-AI semiconductor applications. Bookings number not verified; do not invent one.

supply_signals.type: Recognized revenue and company operating cash flow
supply_signals.caveat: Cloud memory and core data center include more than AI/HBM. Revenue growth can reflect pricing, mix, and shipments; it is not a pure unit-demand metric. Multi-year customer agreements are forward commitments, not already recognized revenue.
